name: Contact
source:
Main character Mike comes in the summer to see his grandmother. She runs a local store, but things are not going the way she did a couple of years ago.
Mike decides to help her grandmother restore her household and meet her old friends at the same time.
translation:
主角迈克在夏天来看望他的祖母。她在当地经营一家商店，但事情并没有像几年前那样发展。
迈克决定帮助她的祖母恢复她的家庭，同时会见她的老朋友。
